description: Close the four residual delegation gaps left by advisor-first orchestration (#988/PR #991): release dependents only on advisor acceptance, replace maximum-parallelism sizing slogans with useful bounded sizing, reconcile interrupted running tasks on resume, and remove the undefined Memory Protocol and the after-planning execution trigger while preserving the read-only --dry-run contract.

userStories.title: Gate dependency release on advisor acceptance
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a wave's dependents to start only after I have accepted the artifacts they consume, so that a defective worker result cannot propagate into downstream work.
acceptanceCriteria: delegate/SKILL.md step 5b distinguishes a worker's reported completed status from advisor acceptance and names the recorded acceptance state that step 5d reads

Step 5d passes accepted artifacts and accepted summaries forward; an unaccepted or failed result blocks its dependents and returns the defect to the bounded writer named in the task's failure/repair route
Step 6's integrated validation remains a separate, still-required check; per-task acceptance does not replace it
The change reuses the existing pending/running/completed/FAIL/BLOCKED state model and existing evidence ownership; no new lifecycle is introduced
A disposable-context exercise records dependency eligibility before checking, after a failed check, and after a verified repair, with real observations in evidence.md
delegate-worker-boundary.sh and advisor-execution-contract.sh exit 0
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Skill 5b/5c/5d + Status field revised; advisor-run injection: old 5d text -> exit 1. D2 runtime row observed in a disposable context: dependent releasable False (returned, unverified) -> False (verification failed, exit 0 but wrong output) -> True (verified acceptance). Repair routed to the same worker by native continuation.

userStories.title: Replace maximum-parallelism slogans with useful bounded sizing
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want sizing guidance that names the factors deciding a task boundary, so that I neither split coupled work artificially nor spawn workers a sequential task does not need.
acceptanceCriteria: The core principle at delegate/SKILL.md:19 no longer instructs the advisor to maximize parallelism; dependency order remains absolute

The decomposition rule at :199 no longer prefers more smaller tasks by default; complexity, briefing overhead, shared context, and verification cost decide the boundary, and one continuing bounded worker is a valid answer
Max 5 concurrent agents per wave and the recursion-authorization limits are unchanged

The dispatch record requires scope, selection reason, search/output limits, expected evidence, and a stopping condition in the worker brief; the search/output-limits and stopping-condition fields are ADDED by this change (independent review established they were absent at the base, so the earlier 'still requires' wording was false)
No scheduler, no new machinery, and no unmeasured efficiency or token-savings claim is added
One coupled, one independent, and one mechanical brief are reviewed against the revised skill and recorded in evidence.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Core principle and decomposition rule rewritten; Search / output limits and Stopping condition added to the dispatch record (R3). Concurrency and recursion caps pinned. D3 three-brief review performed and recorded, including a finding against the advisor's own briefs.

userStories.title: Reconcile interrupted running tasks on resume
userStories.description: As the advisor resuming a delegation, I want running tasks reconciled against real worker state and artifacts, so that I never spawn a duplicate writer or accept a completion label whose evidence has gone stale.
acceptanceCriteria: Step 4's resume rule covers running: inspect the persisted native worker reference and current artifacts before any retry
A worker still active is reconnected to or observed through the supported native mechanism; spawning a duplicate for it is forbidden
A worker that ended has its artifacts validated before the advisor decides to accept, resume, or retry only the incomplete scope
Unknown native status or unknown artifact provenance is reported as ambiguity and blocks duplicate writes
A saved completed label whose evidence no longer describes the required artifact revision is not trusted
The resume path still appends to delegate-log.txt and never truncates it
Active, ended-with-valid-artifacts, interrupted-incomplete, unknown-status, and stale-evidence cases are exercised and recorded in evidence.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Resume rule now covers pending/BLOCKED, FAIL (incomplete scope only), running (reconnect, never duplicate), completed (stale-evidence check) and unknown provenance. Five cases exercised; a real end-to-end resume reconciliation found and fixed defect A-1.

userStories.title: Remove the undefined Memory Protocol and the accidental execution trigger
userStories.description: As a reader of the skill, I want every procedure reference to resolve and planning alone to dispatch nothing, so that loading the skill or finishing a plan cannot start execution or write execution state.
acceptanceCriteria: No Memory Protocol reference remains in delegate/SKILL.md (currently :125, :132, :145, :162); no memory subsystem is created to satisfy the stale text
The frontmatter trigger at :5 no longer fires on /prd or plan creation; the description keeps its valid triggers and the skill frontmatter contract (name, description, argument-hint)
The Decision Flow diagram branches on --dry-run before the run-ledger write, matching the prose rule at :260 that --dry-run writes neither file
--dry-run remains read-only: it emits the task graph and wave plan, dispatches no worker, and creates no execution state
A plan-only request and an authorized --dry-run are exercised with native dispatch events and execution-state files observed before and after; neither dispatches a worker nor creates execution state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Memory Protocol references 0; frontmatter trigger no longer fires on /prd or plan creation and resists sibling-command evasion; diagram branches on --dry-run before the ledger write, pinned by literal-edge assertions. Dry-run observed: 0 execution-state files and no dispatch event before or after.

userStories.title: Extend the two contract probes to pin the corrected behavior
userStories.description: As the maintainer, I want the corrected contracts pinned by the existing probes, so that a future edit cannot silently reopen any of the four gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: delegate-worker-boundary.sh and advisor-execution-contract.sh gain checks for acceptance-before-release, useful sizing, running-task reconciliation, resolved procedure references, and the preserved read-only --dry-run contract
No parallel test framework is created; both probes keep their existing structure and runner contract
Each added check rejects its targeted mutation in a disposable copy and passes after restoration; the injected fault and the restored pass are recorded with exit codes
Each negative assertion binds its negation to the token it forbids rather than to a whole sentence (pattern-evals-negation-must-govern-token)
Both probes exit 0 on the integrated result
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Both probes extended; advisor ran 8 independent injections (all mutated exit 1 / restored exit 0, plus an unmodified control at 0); T1 reports 31 round-1 and 17 repair-round injections with raw output retained; T2 independently confirmed 4. shellcheck absent from the sandbox — recorded as a gap.

userStories.title: Prove the merged contracts and the suite still hold
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want the predecessor's contracts and the wider probe suite verified on the integrated commit, so that no merged guarantee is weakened and no new regression ships.
acceptanceCriteria: delegate-model-effort-policy.sh, spec-single-owner.sh, plan-orchestration-contract.sh, and roles-are-skills.sh each exit 0 on the integrated result
link-providers.sh --check exits 0; the canonical .oh/ source was edited and no provider mirror was patched
eval/run.sh runs on the approved base and on the integrated result; every non-PASS row is reviewed and each pre-existing failure is reproduced on the base before being attributed elsewhere
The suite run, not a name grep, is the authoritative list of affected probes (pattern-evals-probe-brief-under-enumeration)

The merged model/effort policy, no-Sonnet exclusion, requested-vs-observed evidence rule, single-owner ownership, optional handoff, and the audit gate-4/gate-5 completion contract are unchanged by this diff
Real exit codes and the tested commit are recorded in evidence.md; a skipped check is recorded as a gap, never as a pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Six named probes plus five more exit 0; link-providers --check 0; eval runner exit 0 on base 56ab2bab (137 PASS/7 SKIPPED/1 RED, retained as a committed artifact) and on the final head (138 PASS/6 SKIPPED/1 RED). No new green->red. Eight merged contracts verified present.

userStories.title: Record the core-versus-deferred disposition
userStories.description: As the operator, I want every deferred item to carry an explicit disposition, so that the follow-up register stays visible without this PR silently absorbing or silently dropping it.
acceptanceCriteria: evidence.md gives an explicit disposition to each retained register row: audit gate-3 remote-PR/local-HEAD mismatch, audit gate-5 metric-base skew, openharness-web documentation, probe robustness, the three known environment failures (curl-bash-safe-alternatives, oh-config-surfaces, skills-vendored), the optional efficiency comparison, live transfer testing, and historical unknown model/effort observations
The final diff touches none of the deferred surfaces; audit/scripts/route-driver.sh and probes/audit-run-root-contract.sh are read-only in this task
No paid experiment and no external documentation change is started without separate operator approval
Historical unknown model and effort observations are preserved as unknown; no retrospective setting is manufactured
The final diff is compared against the four core gaps and every register row, and the comparison is recorded
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Every retained register row dispositioned in evidence.md; diff touches no deferred surface; historical unknown model/effort observations preserved as unknown.
